invariant: model capability can change without changing principal authority

stories.story: Meta launches Muse cross-app autonomous agent
stories.reason: Current baseline already requires explicit consent for sensitive cross-domain transitions, scoped single-use credentials for consequential effects, and keeps external safety/scanner agents advisory.

stories.story: Google commits €13B to Finland AI infrastructure
stories.reason: Infrastructure location or supplier trust is deployment evidence only and must not widen principal authority; no new primitive is justified.
Current accessibility adapters already normalize visual-description intent without raw-sensor retention or authority inheritance.

stories.story: FTA ICAM pilot closes September 9 with $11.96M available
stories.reason: The current baseline already contains the ICAM partner/funding artifact; duplicate outreach artifacts would add noise, not capability.
A stronger or better-funded model supplier does not alter principal authority; model-supplier substitution is already covered by the authority invariant.
